brief:
# Assessment

Choose use-partner for assignment management. Reuse surviving repositories where suitable, but inventory external tests and rosters separately rather than assuming all Classroom state survives.

GitHub Classroom website, APIs and related services are decommissioned as of August 28, 2026.

Classroom-created accounts, repositories and organizations are unaffected.

Some Classroom data, including LTI rosters and tests outside repositories, will be permanently deleted.
